newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH- LEHMAN UPGRADES HEINEKEN TO BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH- LEHMAN UPGRADES HEINEKEN TO BUY.

text.p: Lehman Brothers raised its rating on Heineken to "buy" from "outperform".

The change of stance is based on the view that a double digit rate of growth will begin in the second half of 1997 due to continued U.S. volume growth and a soaring dollar. Comparisons with Europe are also much easier in both weather and provisions, a Lehman Brothers note said.
Lehman said it believed the rate of growth will continue into 1998 and 1999.
